evidence.citation: Artifact: "The single passing rerun does not prove the skill. For a material or borderline case, repeat the blind run 2–3 times and report the per-case pass rate." Also: "After any edit, rerun every golden case... using fresh blind agents and the required repetitions."
evidence.criterion: C1: The artifact does not require materially unnecessary execution work under the supplied cost evaluation bar.

rationale: The artifact’s extra execution work is tied to diagnosis, nondeterminism, and regression verification under the corrected bar. The repeated blind reruns and full post-edit sweep are justified as reproducibility and regression-status controls, so they are not materially unnecessary under C1.
